resources.string: PositionMe needs precise location and physical activity access to collect a useful positioning session. These permissions are requested only when you choose to record. You can still open and manage saved sessions without them.
Recording needs precise location and physical activity access. Saved sessions remain available.
Location or physical activity access was denied. Open app settings to allow it before recording. Saved sessions remain available without these permissions.
Bluetooth and nearby Wi-Fi access can add radio positioning observations. Notifications keep long recordings visible. These permissions are optional; you can continue recording without them.
Bluetooth, nearby Wi-Fi, or notifications were not allowed. Recording and saved sessions are still available. You can change these permissions in app settings.
Ready to record. Tap Start when you are ready.
